learning_outcomes.text: Know the basic principles of fluid mechanics and their application to solving problems in the field of engineering. Calculation of pipes, channels and fluid systems.
Understand the concept of fluid and the molecular origin of its properties.
Be able to apply the equations of Fluid Mechanics to solve engineering problems.
Know the basic procedures for experimentation in Fluid Mechanics.
Be able to calculate and interpret drag and lift forces, as well as the factors influencing an object's aerodynamic behavior.
Understand the origin and be able to evaluate pressure losses in fluid conduits.

assessment_methods.method: Written exam of problems and theoretical questions
CFD simulation of a problem proposed by the professor
Optional activities (classroom participation, CFD projects proposed by the student...)

assessment_rules: The overall grade must be at least 5/10 points to pass the course. If the written exam score is less than 2.5/10, the overall grade for the course cannot exceed 4 points. If either the laboratory practice score or the CFD simulation score is below 5, the maximum overall grade obtainable is 9.4 points. To be eligible for 'Matrícula de Honor', a minimum overall grade of 9.5/10 is required. The grade is calculated using the formula: NOTA = 0.8 * EXAMEN + 0.1 * MAX(PRACTICAS, EXAMEN) + 0.1 * MAX(CFD, EXAMEN) + EXTRA.
